name: Being Proud
overview: Scripture warns against pride as a form of evil that God hates, linking it to arrogance and despising others (Proverbs 8:13; Luke 18:9). The disciples' question about greatness in the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 18:1) contrasts worldly pride with the humility Christ teaches. Coveting what belongs to others reflects a proud heart that disregards God’s commands (Exodus 20:17), while the deceitfulness of pride aligns with the father of lies, the devil (John 8:44). Together, these verses reveal that being proud opposes the fear of the Lord and the humility required to walk in truth.
